description: Firecracker microVM sandboxes for AI agents: run commands, read and write files, start processes, preview ports, and pause and wake with memory kept. Billed on active CPU ($0.025 per vCPU-hour), no plan fee.

notes: The remote endpoint uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; a request with no key gets a 401 pointing at the protected resource metadata.
The local npx bridge connects with a one-time browser approval; servers and CI can send Authorization: Bearer with a Runtime API key.
Submitted by the Runtime team. Official MCP Registry name: com.withruntime/runtime.
